head.authoritative_wording: Proposal is being prepared or submitted; no Trial is assessable yet.

scope_review.relation_rationale: The primary endpoint is the requested composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up, in the randomized early-surgery versus conservative-care groups, analyzed by intention to treat from randomization through follow-up ending four years after the last enrollee.

target.outcome: Composite of operative mortality or cardiovascular death during follow-up
target.measurement: Operative mortality (death during or within 30 days after surgery) or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up, adjudicated by an independent clinical-events committee.
target.window: From randomization through follow-up until four years after the last patient was enrolled; median follow-up was 6.2 years in early surgery and 6.1 years in conservative care.
target.population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

reported_endpoint.name: Primary end point: operative mortality or death from cardiovascular causes during follow-up

scope_review.reported_analysis_population: All randomized patients in an intention-to-treat analysis: 73 assigned to early surgery and 72 assigned to conservative care.
scope_review.instruction: Compare outcome definition, time window, estimand and population against the selected source passages. Null reported timing/estimand means not separately represented, not absent from the source. Known target fields, a matching endpoint label, or bound numbers do not prove exactness. Keep material conflict/uncertainty in clarity and rationale; choose a supported non-exact relation or another candidate when exact scope is not established. Do not redefine the target.
